page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c48g1.12xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.9 GHz, utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 310.0 GB of system memory, providing 6.46 GB of RAM per core. For hardware acceleration, it includes a single NVIDIA Ampere A10 GPU with 24 GB of VRAM. This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage must be network-attached, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier performance in specific workloads, particularly in large language model (LLM) inference. For a small 135M model, the instance achieves prompt processing speeds of 9711.08 tokens per second and text generation speeds of 456.51 tokens per second. For a medium 7B model, it processes prompts at 2509.43 tokens per second and generates text at 90.44 tokens per second, both falling into the top-tier performance category. Other areas show strong performance, such as multi-threaded bzip3 decompression at 230.87 GB/sec, Geekbench image processing at 15395.0, and PassMark CPU encryption at 42228.64. Most general CPU and memory benchmarks, including Geekbench single-core (1613.0) and multi-core (15234.0) scores, fall within the average range.

From a resource density perspective, this instance offers a specialized balance of dedicated Intel Xeon CPU cores and a single NVIDIA Ampere GPU, making it qualitatively cost-effective for targeted AI inference and graphics rendering tasks rather than general-purpose compute. The lack of local storage is a notable tradeoff, requiring external storage solutions for data-heavy operations. The instance is appropriate for workloads such as medium-scale LLM inference, image processing, cryptographic operations, and multi-threaded decompression tasks.
